replacements.old: same person can be linked to more than one party
replacements.new: a person must have a separate Contact for each linked party

replacements.old: Keep the person as one Contact and use links for their business relationships. This avoids duplicate phone numbers and email addresses when one person represents several organizations.
replacements.new: Create a separate Contact for each business relationship. Reuse the same phone number and email address across those Contact records when one person represents several organizations.

replacements.old: You can add more links later when the same person represents another entity.
replacements.new: When the same person represents another entity, create a new Contact instead of adding another link.
